svg.aria-label: The Cerebro fleet: five human roles, six agent roles, the bead board and the fleet view
svg.text: six agent roles, one bead board, and the humans they answer to
bd — one queue, every agent reads it
claim one bead · build it test-first in its own worktree
open the PR · answer Copilot · merge green · report done
then the fleet view retires it and starts a fresh session
s starts · k kills · f finishes · one human watching them all
stop flags, a release when asked
CLOSED IS NOT TERMINAL — a failed verdict reopens the bead at P0 and sends it round again
